title: Say Shibboleth: Fingerprinting the LLMs and Harnesses Behind Agentic Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2611.12386v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the fingerprinting of agentic cyberattacks. Our objective is to reliably infer information about the attacker's configuration, such as LLM version and harness, from telemetry. To achieve this, we introduce a technique we call shibboleth traps: modular honeypot services designed to elicit discriminative behaviors from agentic attackers. The traps make informative interactions a condition for obtaining resources the agent seeks, eliciting model declarations and characteristic writing without requiring a successful prompt injection.   To achieve harness fingerprinting, we introduce general mechanisms to indirectly probe peculiar execution behaviors of harnesses. These probes reveal how a harness masks secrets in tool output, enforces command time limits, and schedules tool calls, using only the effects visible in subsequent requests. translated_title: 说出暗语：对智能体攻击背后的大语言模型与框架进行指纹识别
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.12386v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：我们研究了智能体网络攻击的指纹识别技术。我们的目标是可靠地从遥测数据中推断攻击者的配置信息，例如所使用的大语言模型版本和代理框架。为此，我们提出了一种称为“暗语陷阱”的技术：一种模块化蜜罐服务，旨在诱使智能体攻击者表现出可区分的行为。这些陷阱将信息性交互作为攻击者获取所需资源的前提条件，无需成功实施提示注入即可引出模型的自我声明和特征性写作。为实现对代理框架的指纹识别，我们引入了通用机制来间接探测框架特有的执行行为。这些探测器仅通过后续请求中可见的效果，即可揭示框架如何在工具输出中掩蔽敏感信息、如何强制执行命令时间限制，以及如何调度工具调用。我们证明，结合声明性推断与行为性推断能够区分15个候选……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种名为“暗语陷阱”的模块化蜜罐技术，通过结合声明性推断与行为性推断，从遥测数据中指纹识别智能体网络攻击背后的大语言模型版本和代理框架。
en_tdlr: We introduce "shibboleth traps," modular honeypot services that combine declarative and behavioral inference to fingerprint the LLM versions and agent harnesses behind agentic cyberattacks from telemetry alone.
